item.tib: DAk+ki'i snying thig bla sgrub rak+Sha thod phreng gi grol byed khrid kyi gdams pa
item.coloph: ces pa'ang sa spyod kyi 'og min nyag gnas zangs mdog dpal ri/ zhes pa'i gnas su rje btsun ma chos kyi dbang mo'i rmi lam du dag pa'i snang ba la/ sku dang yig 'bru shar ba dang gsung gi sgra yang yang thos pa'i brda la brten nas/ brda tshig yi ge'i lam du bkod pa'i/ yang zab mkha' 'gro'i snying thig bla sgrub rak+Sha thod phreng 'di la gzhung don phrin las kyi bsnyen sgrub smin byed dbang dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i/ chos sde'i nang tshan du grol byed khrid kyi gdams pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa 'di khol bur phyung ba ste/ 'di'i dgongs pa gsal bar bsdus khrid tsam byed po/ rgyal bstan ris bral dgongs pa'i bdud rtsi la longs spyod thob pa/ b+hu su ku sa ye rdor gyis bris pas yongs su dge bar gyur cig/
